sources.title: Introducing Whisper - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've trained and are open-sourcing a neural net called Whisper that approaches human level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition.

sources.title: GitHub - openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak ...
sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: whisper/model-card.md at main · openai/whisper · GitHub
sources.snippet: Model Use Evaluated Use The primary intended users of these models are AI researchers studying the robustness, generalization, capabilities, biases, and constraints of the current model. However, Whisper is also potentially quite useful as an ASR solution for developers, especially for English speech recognition.
